what: A small figure stuck to the bottom of the section (character, Lottie) is tied to scroll and crawls from the section’s left edge to its right edge — 0 when the section top touches the bottom of the screen, 1 when the section bottom leaves the top of the screen, with left p% and translateX(−p%) so the figure never sticks out of the section at either end. No curve, 1:1 with scroll

options.start: Start position (ScrollTrigger start), default top bottom
options.end: End position (ScrollTrigger end), default bottom top
options.dir: With left, it runs from the right edge to the left edge (default right)
options.track: Selector of the board to cross (nearest ancestor), default parent

note: Images are placed with position: absolute inside the panel (the part uses left). Even if the panel is not overflow: hidden, nothing spills past either end

from.where: index.js·index.css .concerns__cat (melted cat Lottie crawling along the floor of the concerns section)
